desc: tool to extract mod_log_forensic output from apache log files
u: check_forensic - tool to extract mod_log_forensic output from apache log files

chech_forensic is a simple shell script designed to help apache administrators to extract mod_log_forensic output from apache2 log files. It checks the forensic log for requests that did not complete and outputs the request log for each one.
This manual page was written by Fabio M. Di Nitto <fabbione@fabbione.net>, for the Debian GNU/Linux system (but may be used by others).
